biotools.summary: Plain-text, git-tracked electronic lab notebook (ELN) for reproducible bioinformatics — threads your R & Python figures into living lab notes with full provenance. Built for single-cell / CyTOF / flow cytometry; works with Obsidian, Quarto & Jupyter.
